category_title: Struggling readers who forget intended dictation during technology delays
scenario_title: Dictating a patterned story using Speech Recognition
minimal_context: David is at the writing center using the Dragon Speech Recognition app on an iPad to dictate his own version of a patterned story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's write your version of the Brown Bear story on the iPad. Press the button to dictate your sentence about the Transformer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Touches the dictation button and goes blank) I want to write... um...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should say?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I see a Transformer driving by me. (Looks at the screen) The app timed out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try pressing the button and saying it again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Repeats the process three times) It typed the wrong words again! (Deletes the entire sentence) I don't want to do this anymore.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's write your version of the Brown Bear story on the iPad. Press the button to dictate your sentence about the Transformer.

STUDENT: (Touches the dictation button and goes blank) I want to write... um...

TUTOR: What do you think you should say?

STUDENT: I see a Transformer driving by me. (Looks at the screen) The app timed out.

TUTOR: Try pressing the button and saying it again.

STUDENT: (Repeats the process three times) It typed the wrong words again! (Deletes the entire sentence) I don't want to do this anymore.

task.content: Composing his own version of Brown Bear, Brown Bear, What Do You See? and dictating 'I see a Transformer driving by me.'

context.environment: Writing center during the morning reading block
context.materials: iPad, Dragon Speech Recognition (SR) app, chart paper

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After repeating the process three times only to have Dragon incorrectly transcribe

behavior_patterns.condition: When touching the dictation button to launch SR
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Struggled to remember what they wanted to dictate
Wanted to skip brainstorming and drafting and go straight to revising
